Attention, documentation, care, and continuity are operational rather than decorative: listening and observation lead to requirements and verification; source maps, minutes, decision logs, handoffs, and correction paths preserve context; hospitality, consent, privacy, accessibility, repair, and protected records constrain publication; reusable patterns enable others to continue.
